reviewer: Codex visual review, not human certification
coordinate_system: Rectified quad coordinates 0..100, polygons include their boundary
provenance: All 50 context/crop pairs reviewed with expected sprite, model masks and matcher results hidden. Some frames were seen in prior research. Labels are conservative visible non-target material/uncertainty judgments, not oracle depth ownership.
default: Unmarked pixels remain potential evidence, subject to the unchanged colour gate. Unmarked is not certified target ownership.
